content.short: We want to Build an ecosystem for the rugpull NFT, Stake your rugpull alongside one of our home NFTs and receive an amount of $BChip each epoch.
content.description:
Are you tired of being rugged by unserious project or blatant cashgrab? We know we are! This is why we bring you the Brown Chips! No more false promise of blue chips, but maybe the hope of bringing back a little value to all those rugpulls laying dead in your wallets! Join our community and let's do something with all those broken hopes of NFTs.

Soon we will be launching our home collection of NFT to helps us fund the project and build a future home for those now useless NFTs. Our systems will allow you to stake those rugged NFTs with a minimum of one of our home NFT and receive $BChips as a reward each epoch. Our plan is to list our token on DEX, hold exclusive mint only in $Bchip, build an extensive ranking system based on yours holdings of $BChips, A voting system for holders to help us determine which project should be allowed as a rugpull in the BChip Staking pool and makes littles games also playable with $BChips!

Our goal is to bring back a little value to all the dead projects via staking rewards, memes and community effort. We can easily see a future where people buy $BChip off a DEX to participate in an exclusive mint, made by an artist renowned hired with the royalties... Or even people buying cocoloco off the secondary market to Stake them in our Staking system!

Let's be honest we all been rugged at some point, why not, together, build something great out of it anyway and have fun on the road?
